title: EmDash media deletion distinguishes page references, library storage, and cached public URLs
steps: From the checkout under test, run `pnpm --filter @tracy/dsh-site-tools exec node --test test/emdash.test.mjs test/emdash-call.test.mjs`.
Keep the TAP output as evidence. The fake EmDash MCP site returns both storageDeleted:true and storageDeleted:false media_delete answers; no live library item is changed.
expect: The EmDash prompt says content_update removes a picture reference from a page; media_delete removes its media-library record and stored file, leaves page references unchanged, and may break them.
The prompt says media_delete does not revoke a public URL and cannot promise cached URLs stop serving; it adds no purge or deny integration.

When storageDeleted is true, the successful media_delete response says the stored file was deleted, page references remain, and a cached public URL may still serve; it forbids claiming the URL is revoked or unreachable.

When storageDeleted is false, the response says the library record was removed but the stored file may remain and may still be served from origin; it does not claim the file is gone, and says a cached public URL may still serve.
The unconfirmed media_delete asks the customer before any delete call; the confirmation gate is unchanged.

tests: the tracy_emdash description is the road (T9)
the EmDash prompt separates page removal, library deletion, and public URL revocation
a confirmed media_delete with storageDeleted:true reports file removal without claiming the public URL was revoked
a confirmed media_delete with storageDeleted:false says the stored file may remain and still serve
each of the ten destructive tools asks first, with no exec

evidence: Issue #1304: origin deletion does not establish that a public URL served through an edge cache is unavailable.
fence: content_update changes/removes the page reference; media_delete removes the library row, but the stored file is confirmed removed only when storageDeleted is true; cached public URL unavailability is not guaranteed and no CDN purge or deny integration is added.
